versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

- Initial release of the dataify-bing-maps skill.
- Converts natural-language Bing Maps requests to Dataify Bing Maps API fields and calls the bundled script.
- Always displays a full Markdown table of API parameters for user confirmation before live calls.
- Supports environment-based authentication and prompts for a Dataify API token if not set.
- Directly returns API responses to the user with no additional processing or summarization.
- Enforces safe defaults and strictly maps only explicit user input to optional fields.
